req_desc: The app presents one shared global map dataset to every visitor.
The app serves readers who hold no account.
The app offers no likes, no follows, no private messages.
A visitor reads the map without an account ...
A mapper opens a changeset after signing in ...
The app rejects a mutating API call from a signed-out session ...
The app creates a mapper account from a submitted email with a password ...
The app returns a bearer token from `/api/auth/login`.
The app stores every password hashed.
The app denies a mutating request carrying an expired token.
The app stores a node as a single point at a latitude with a longitude.
The app stores a way as an ordered list of node references.
The app stores a relation as an ordered list of members carrying roles.
The app stores a version on every element.
The app stores tags as free-form `key=value` strings.
The app lets one way belong to several relations at once.
The app refuses a way referencing a node that does not exist.
The app refuses deleting a node that is `still in use`.
The app opens a changeset for a signed-in mapper.
The app applies a batch of creates, modifies, deletes in one upload.
The app applies no part of a batch when any element in the batch is refused.
The app refuses a further upload to a closed changeset.
The app raises a touched element to exactly one higher version.
The app computes a changeset bounding box from the elements the changeset touched.
The app rejects a changeset writing more than `500` elements.
The app returns the saved element value after a reload.
The app retains every version of every element.
The app returns every version of a node oldest first.
The app writes a delete as a new version marked `visible` false.
The app returns the changeset stream newest first.
The app lists the exact elements one changeset wrote.
The app resolves an element to the mapper who last touched the element.
The app never alters an older version row.
The app creates a new changeset restoring elements a named changeset touched.
The app attributes a revert to the mapper who asked for the revert.
The app keeps reverted versions readable.
The app refuses a revert whose elements moved to newer versions.
The app warns before upload about a way crossing itself.
The app lets a mapper upload over a dismissed warning.
The app refuses only structural violations at upload.
The app opens a full-viewport map of the dataset at the site root.
The app positions square tiles by a zoom-column-row address.
The app shows a welcome card to a first-time visitor ...
The app drops a result pin for a matched place search.
The app shows an attribution line naming Openhaven contributors.
The app returns one map tile `256` pixels square.
The app serves tiles no deeper than zoom `19`.
The app draws tiles on demand per tile.
The app caches a drawn tile.
The app marks a tile stale when an edit changes data inside the tile bounds.
The app returns every element inside a `bbox`.
The app rejects a bbox larger than `0.25` square degrees.
The app rejects a request returning more than `5000` elements.
The app returns a seconds-old element from a covering bbox request.
The app downloads raw elements for the area in view.
The app renders an about page carrying five named sections.
The app lists diary entries newest first.
The app makes a whole help card clickable.
The app rejects invalid form input inline, naming the wrong field.
The app renders its own not-found page for an unmatched address.
The app routes a signed-out request for the editor to the login page ...
The app shows a loading state during tile drawing ...
The app names the stored version to the mapper whose upload was rejected.
The app renders body text in a deep cool neutral ...
The app sets body copy at `14px` ...
The app eases every entrance so movement reads as designed ...
The app meets the WCAG AA contrast bar on body text ...
The app overflows nothing sideways at a narrow viewport.
The app fetches no image file ...
The app draws every icon as inline vector geometry.
The app labels the search control with the word Search ...
The app runs a Remix frontend on Node 20 ...
The app introduces no second database.
The app applies exactly one of two simultaneous uploads claiming the same element version ...
The app gives every public route a distinct title.
The app serves a sitemap at `/sitemap.xml` ...
The app stores ten tables ...
The app accepts `deku-demo-pw-2026` at login for every seeded account ...
The app identifies an element by an id together with a version.
The app stores the order of a way's nodes as a sequence.
The app seeds a node named `Riverside Cafe` ...
The app duplicates no row when the app restarts.
The app offers no GPS trace upload ...
The app offers no moderator tier.
The app makes no external network call at runtime.
The app downloads no binary asset.
The app stays responsive with fifty thousand elements.
The app reads its public address from `APP_PUBLIC_URL` ...
The app serves the HTTP API under the `/api` prefix.
The app answers `/api/health` with status `200`.
The app starts from the environment image with no manual steps.
The app creates an empty `.browser_screenshots/` directory at the app root.
The app serves a production build behind a preview server.
The app keeps the server running after the session ends.
The app binds `0.0.0.0`.
The app starts no copy of the backing service.
The app returns a top-level JSON array from the node history endpoint.
core asks covered by this grader
